matches.title: USA vs South Korea
matches.description: Watch USA vs South Korea highlights and goals from Friendly on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on September 7, 2025. A capacity crowd gathered to witness a tactical showdown between two nations looking to refine their squads ahead of major international commitments. The atmosphere was electric as both sides tested their limits in a contest defined by clinical finishing and late-game tension. Early Dominance and a Stunning Response The match on September 7, 2025, began with immediate intensity as Germany sought to establish control. It took only two minutes for the deadlock to be broken when Joshua Kimmich delivered a precise cross that found Kai Havertz , who expertly headed the ball into the net. The early goal forced the USA to regroup, and despite several offside calls disrupting their rhythm, the Americans began to find their footing through the set-piece delivery of Christian Pulisic . The persistence of the home side paid off in the 37th minute. Following a corner, Antonee Robinson produced a moment of magic, connecting with a left-footed volley that flew past the German goalkeeper. The equalizer sent the crowd of over 63,000 into a frenzy, setting the stage for a competitive second period after an evenly matched first half. Tactical Shifts and Second Half Decider The second half saw both managers turn to their benches to maintain high energy levels. However, it was Germany who regained the lead in the 57th minute. Kai Havertz turned provider this time, setting up Leroy Sané , whose left-footed effort took a deflection before nestling in the back of the net. The goal swung the momentum back in favor of the visitors, forcing the USA into a triple substitution as Brenden Aaronson and Ricardo Pepi were introduced to spark a comeback. Frantic Finish and Defensive Discipline As the clock ticked toward 90 minutes, the match grew increasingly physical. The USA pushed forward with desperation, seeing a shot from Giovanni Reyna blocked and a long-range effort from Brenden Aaronson saved by Oliver Baumann . The closing stages were marked by a flurry of disciplinary actions, as Maximilian Beier , Timothy Weah , and Nico Schlotterbeck all received yellow cards during a heated stoppage-time period. Despite the American pressure, Germany held firm to secure a hard-fought victory in a contest where they just managed to carve out the decisive advantage.
